traits.notes: Multiple images show the same seedling from different angles. The plant has a whorled arrangement of simple, elliptic leaves with entire margins, clustered at the apex of a green, herbaceous stem. Some leaves show minor damage (holes and margin loss), but no signs of pathogens or insects are evident. A pink tag is attached to the stem, likely for research or monitoring purposes. The seedling is growing on a forest floor covered in moist, decomposing leaf litter. The leaf surface is shiny and glabrous, with clearly visible pinnate venation. No stipules, latex, or pulvinus are observed. The petioles are long and terete.
